{{Top|leg|canon=Transport ticketing droid}}
'''Ticket droids''' were used at sporting venues. Individuals looking for entry into the venue had to pass by theme. Individuals with [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] credentials could use their identification to bypass ticket droids.
